title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten named University of Portland study settings, selected for documented seating, quiet-space, or project-work features.

cards.title: Franz Lounge
cards.subtitle: Dundon-Berchtold Hall
cards.notes: Set up with a reading or writing task at a coffee table or armchair; the university describes the lounge as having settees, coffee tables, and armchairs.
cards.short_summary: A furnished lounge setting inside Dundon-Berchtold Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland identifies Franz Lounge as a study location with settees, coffee tables, and armchairs.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Located in Dundon-Berchtold Hall; confirm building access and room availability on arrival.

cards.title: First-Floor Hallway Seating
cards.subtitle: Dundon-Berchtold Hall
cards.notes: Use the desk-and-chair stations for focused work, or choose couch and armchair seating; wall outlets support device charging.
cards.short_summary: Hallway seating with desks, soft seating, outlets, and lawn-facing windows.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland describes first-floor hallway study areas with desks, chairs, couches, armchairs, wall outlets, and windows onto the lawn.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Inside Dundon-Berchtold Hall; use open seating and avoid blocking hallway circulation.

cards.title: Second-Floor Hallway Seating
cards.subtitle: Dundon-Berchtold Hall
cards.notes: Bring a charged laptop and pick between desk seating and couches by the lawn-facing windows; use wall outlets when available.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor open study area with mixed seating and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland lists the second-floor hallways as study spaces with desks, chairs, couches, armchairs, outlets, and lawn-facing windows.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Inside Dundon-Berchtold Hall; availability varies with classes and events.

cards.title: Basement Hallway Study Area
cards.subtitle: Dundon-Berchtold Hall
cards.notes: Choose a desk set or couch seating for a distraction-light session; the university notes this floor has the same seating types as other study hallways.
cards.short_summary: A basement-level hallway option with desks and soft seating.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland describes the Dundon-Berchtold basement hallway as a low-traffic study area with desk sets plus couch seating.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Inside Dundon-Berchtold Hall; check that the hallway remains open for academic use.

cards.title: Clark Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Clark Library
cards.notes: Reserve a group room when a project needs a contained workspace; the university lists 20 reservable group study rooms in Clark Library.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for collaborative study in the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland states that Clark Library has 20 reservable group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; use the library’s current room-reservation system for availability and eligibility.

cards.title: Clark Library Study Booths
cards.subtitle: Clark Library
cards.notes: Reserve a booth for a compact work session or pair meeting; the university identifies five reservable study booths in the library.
cards.short_summary: Five reservable booths within Clark Library.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland states that Clark Library offers five reservable study booths.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; consult the library’s current booking system before going.

cards.title: Clark Library Individual Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Clark Library
cards.notes: Reserve an individual carrel when you need a defined solo workstation; the university lists 12 individual study carrels among library reservations.
cards.short_summary: Twelve reservable individual workstations in Clark Library.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland states that Clark Library has 12 individual study carrels available as reservable spots.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; check the library’s current booking system and applicable access rules.

cards.title: Vollum Study Room
cards.subtitle: Shiley Hall
cards.notes: Use the two-floor room for desk work or reference consultation; its wall of windows provides natural light across the space.
cards.short_summary: A two-level engineering study room with desks, reference materials, and windows.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland describes the Vollum Study Room as a two-floor space with desks, reference shelves, and a wall of windows.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Located in Shiley Hall; check building access and room conditions before settling in.

cards.title: Quiet Side of Bauccio Commons
cards.subtitle: Bauccio Commons
cards.notes: Bring reading or laptop work to the quieter side of the Commons when it is not in use; wall-adjacent tables offer the documented outlet access.
cards.short_summary: A dining-building study setting with limited wall-outlet seating.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland identifies the Quiet Side of Bauccio Commons as a study option when it is not otherwise in use, noting outlets are by walls.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Use only when the area is not otherwise in use; food purchase is not required by this listing, but is not independently verified.

cards.title: Holy Cross Lounge
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, Franz Hall
cards.notes: Work at the wall banquette seating and use an outlet if available; the lounge is across from the Garaventa Center entrance on Franz Hall’s third floor.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor Franz Hall lounge with banquette seating and historical portraits.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Portland locates Holy Cross Lounge on Franz Hall’s third floor and describes banquette seating, outlets, and portraits of past UP presidents.
cards.source_title: Best Places to Study on Campus
cards.access_notes: Across from the Garaventa Center entrance; confirm lounge availability around scheduled campus activity.
